project.label: Clinical Annotation
project.description: Export of the the clinical data for the selected cohort as anonymised tabular files

project.label: Biosamples
project.description: Based on your selected cohort, please specify next the type of biosample - e.g.: tissue, blood, liquid biopsy, other body fluids, derivates (DNA, RNA, etc.), and the volume, amount or concentration, that you wish to request from the biobanks of the selected sites.

project.label: Molecular Data
project.description:
Based on your selected cohort, please specify the datasets you would like to have exported in anonymized form - e.g.: sequencing, expression and methylation data (alt.: and proteomics data) for your research project.

Note: This data is currently only available through DKFZ/NCT/DKTK MASTER.

project.label: Custom
project.description: Offer a highly configurable export service tailored to advanced users. Researchers can customize export templates, select output formats, and define various parameters to suit specific project needs. This service is ideal for users with in-depth technical knowledge and complex requirements.
